'''Tangar''' was a site of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] activity during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A flotila of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] off Tangar, then jumped again.

It was located near [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]].
